ns2:group.ns2:description:
Capturing video in the ProRes RAW format allows you to grade with incredible flexibility, extending your ability to adjust color, brightness, shadows and more.
Here’s how you can do it ⬇️
• In Settings, tap Camera, tap Formats, then turn on Apple ProRes • Attach an external SSD hard drive via the USB-C port • Download Final Cut Camera • In the app, tap the resolution settings at the top of the screen, then tap ProRes RAW • You can edit ProRes RAW footage on your Mac in the Final Cut Pro app or similar professional video software
Created by @VictoriaEchoBrand. Shared by Apple.
